notes: Breadboard holes read from the circuit image: the orange wire ends in column 3 row g, the resistor spans column 3 to column 6 in row h, the LED legs are in columns 6 (anode, bent longer leg) and 8 (cathode) in row i, and the black wire ends in column 8 row h. Rows f-j are the 'b' bank in the catalogue naming.
The resistor and LED share column 6 (bank b) strip, so the resistor output feeds the LED anode. The LED cathode strip (column 8) is wired to the Uno GND next to pin 13.
GND wire goes to the GND header beside pin 13, which is GND.1 in the catalogue (assumed).
The manual's software (Processing / Max/MSP) and the USB serial link to the computer are not wired hardware, so no USB cable node is included.
